bugMechanismConfirmed.entryPoint: artifacts/smartsite-mcp/src/tools.ts find_parcel handler -> splitFindParcelHits() -> api-server GET /api/brokerage/v1/place/situs-search -> searchPlaceByPrefix()
bugMechanismConfirmed.mechanism: isOutOfCoverageStateCode(locality.state) (txgioAddressNormalize.ts:744-747) only fires on an EXPLICIT, recognised non-TX state token (e.g. '...Phoenix, AZ'). It is a STATE-level check only, keyed off COVERED_STATE_CODE='TX' (txgioAddressNormalize.ts:723). A Texas address in any unonboarded county (Bell/Killeen included) parses to state='TX' or null, so the check never fires; the address then runs the ordinary situs/prefix/address-point search ladder, bounded by storeCountyFipsBound() which spans texasCountyFipsList() -- ALL 254 Texas county FIPS, an index-bound generator, not a coverage claim (txgioAddressNormalize.ts:673-691, explicit in its own doc comment: 'This function is the index bound, not a name directory'). Zero rows come back, and finish() (txgioAddressResolve.ts:1396-1402) falls to missClass:'no-hit' -- indistinguishable from a real in-coverage miss.
bugMechanismConfirmed.existingSixCountyList: CONSTRAINT_SEARCH_COUNTIES (artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelConstraintSearch.ts:49-62) already names exactly the six serving-ledger counties, but it gates a DIFFERENT tool (find_parcels, plural / constraint search) and is not consulted by searchPlaceByPrefix at all. It is also itself a hand-maintained literal array, not a store-derived query -- reusing it would relocate the dispatch's named anti-pattern ('a hardcoded list ... wrong the moment Burnet lands'), not escape it.

designQuestionOpen: Dispatch requires picking ONE of: (a) widen the existing out_of_coverage class to a county-aware check, or (b) add a new, narrower missClass (e.g. county_out_of_coverage) alongside the existing state-level out_of_coverage, distinct because the two failure reasons (never-reached-this-state vs never-onboarded-this-county) may warrant different agentGuidance text. Leaning (b) pending the derivation-source investigation below, because collapsing them loses the ability to tell a caller which axis (state vs county) explains the refusal -- not yet decided; CP2 will carry the decision plus the derivation-source finding, since the two are coupled (the derivation source available determines what the check can even key off).
